page_title: HAI 0-1 SCO | Haiti v Scotland 14/06/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Martin Experience (Haiti) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide.
90+5' Looks like Josue Casimir (Haiti) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
90+5' Mustapha Ghorbal shows a yellow card to Kenny McLean (Scotland) for his blatant foul.
90+4' Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti) produces a nice first-time shot from a promising distance. Angus Gunn pulls off a quality save to stop the ball from hitting the net.
90+3' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+3' Mustapha Ghorbal couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Lyndon Dykes (Scotland) and blew his whistle. Haiti will take a free kick.
90+3' Some great controlled play and passing from Haiti. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90+1' Findlay Curtis (Scotland) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
90+1' Findlay Curtis (Scotland) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
90' We will have 6 min. of added time.
89' The actual number of corner kicks in this match – 4:3. Let's have a look at statistics for the fouls committed by both teams – 23:17.
88' A cross is whipped into the box by Ricardo Ade (Haiti) and Lenny Joseph controls it well. He lines up the ball, but one of the defenders produces a timely intervention.
86' Scott McTominay (Scotland) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
85' It will be a substitution. Yassin Fortune (Haiti) is ready to enter the pitch as Ruben Providence walks off.

85' Chance! Carlens Arcus sends a brilliant curling cross into the heart of the defence and into the path of Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti), whose header from the centre of the box goes a whisker wide of the left post.
83' Steve Clarke has decided to make a change. Kenny McLean (Scotland) replaces Lawrence Shankland.
83' Substitution. Findlay Curtis (Scotland) on for John McGinn.
81' The resulting corner from Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) is cleared.
81' Ruben Providence (Haiti) passes the ball onto Lenny Joseph, but one of the defenders dispossesses him. The ball is out of play. Haiti win a corner kick.
79' A long pass finds Josue Casimir (Haiti), and he decides to test the keeper from long range. The shot flies towards the bottom right corner, but Angus Gunn reacts well to make a good save.
79' Ruben Providence (Haiti) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
79' Ruben Providence (Haiti) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Haiti are going to take it.
78' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but the ball is blocked by one of his teammates.
77' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.
77' Lenny Joseph (Haiti) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. The referee blows his whistle, Haiti are awarded a corner kick.
76' Substitution. Wilson Isidor is replaced by Lenny Joseph (Haiti).
75' The substitution is prepared. Lyndon Dykes (Scotland) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Che Adams.
75' Steve Clarke prepares a substitution. Aaron Hickey is replaced by Nathan Patterson (Scotland).
75' Here comes a substitution. Ryan Christie (Scotland) is brought on as a substitute for Ben Gannon-Doak.
73' Ruben Providence (Haiti) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the right post.
73' A sweet pass inside the box gives John McGinn (Scotland) time to measure a shot, but it's slightly mishit and goes just wide of the right post. That really was a great chance!
73' Total attempts – 8:8. 1:2 - the latest stats for both teams in respect of shots on target.
71' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) puts a cross into the box from the free kick, but the defender gets there first.
71' Mustapha Ghorbal blows the whistle, Danley Jean Jacques (Haiti) is penalised for a foul. A free kick to Scotland.
67' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
65' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) tries to find Danley Jean Jacques, but he puts too much power on the through ball. The ball has crossed the sideline. Scotland are taking a throw-in.
64' The attendance is 64146.
63' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.

62' Danley Jean Jacques (Haiti) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mustapha Ghorbal stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. A free kick has been awarded to Scotland.
61' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Louicius Deedson trots off the pitch and is replaced by Josue Casimir (Haiti).
60' The resulting corner from Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) is cleared by the defence.
59' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat. Now Scotland have a corner.
59' Ruben Providence (Haiti) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Angus Gunn, who smothers the ball.
56' John McGinn (Scotland) is about to take a corner kick.
56' John McGinn (Scotland) takes the corner which is cleared. Scotland earn a corner.
55' Ben Gannon-Doak (Scotland) strikes a promising volley towards goal, but one of the defenders is quick enough to step in and make a crucial block. It will be a corner kick for Scotland.
54' Ruben Providence (Haiti) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Scotland will have a goal kick.
53' Lawrence Shankland (Scotland) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
53' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) rolls the ball short to a teammate from the corner instead of sending a cross into the box.
52' Martin Experience (Haiti) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. The linesman makes the right call and Haiti will have a corner.
51' Grant Hanley (Scotland) sends a long ball forward to Ben Gannon-Doak, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Haiti.
50' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Scotland.
49' Martin Experience (Haiti) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! That's a free kick to Scotland.
47' Ben Gannon-Doak is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Che Adams (Scotland).

47' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) takes the resultant free kick from the edge of the box and tries to find one of his teammates with a cross, but the keeper climbs high and gets to it first, collecting the ball with ease.
46' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aaron Hickey (Scotland) was quite harsh and Mustapha Ghorbal didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Ben Gannon-Doak (Scotland) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
45+2' Che Adams (Scotland) makes a rough challenge and Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle for a foul.
45' There will be a minimum of 4 min. of added time.
45' Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti) is caught offside once again.
42' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well over the bar.
41' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 7:7. Shots on target – 1:2.
41' Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti) is adjudged offside.

40' Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Mustapha Ghorbal with no other option than to blow for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to Scotland.
39' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) has tested the patience of referee Mustapha Ghorbal and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.

36' Wilson Isidor (Haiti) finds himself some space to meet a beautiful cross from the free kick, and from near the penalty spot he attempts to score with a header. His effort lacks accuracy and floats high over the bar.
35' Referee Mustapha Ghorbal sees the trip by Andrew Robertson (Scotland) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle. Haiti are given an advantage. They have a free kick.

34' Ruben Providence (Haiti) gets inside the box and tries to beat Angus Gunn with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save. That was a wasted opportunity to score by Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti). He picks up the rebound and produces a poor effort which is easily saved by the goalkeeper.

34' Ricardo Ade (Haiti) wastes a great chance as he climbs high around the penalty spot to connect with a cross from the resulting free kick. He produces a header, but it goes well wide of the right post.
33' Andrew Robertson (Scotland) jumps into a tackle and Mustapha Ghorbal signals a foul. There is a free kick near the sideline to Haiti.
32' Lawrence Shankland (Scotland) wins the aerial duel to reach the cross from Ben Gannon-Doak, but the ball slips off his head and flies well wide of the left post from close range.
28' 0 - 1 John McGinn (Scotland) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Johny Placide. 0:1.
28' A pass travels right across the box to Che Adams (Scotland) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper in the bottom right corner, but Johny Placide denies him with a decent save.
27' Lewis Ferguson (Scotland) plays a long ball to Lawrence Shankland, but the defence is well organised and manages to get it clear.
23' A cooling break is underway.
23' Louicius Deedson (Haiti) sends a cross into the box, but Angus Gunn comes off his line to gather the ball.
21' A pass by Lawrence Shankland (Scotland) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

17' Louicius Deedson (Haiti) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Scotland.

17' OFF THE POST! Scott McTominay (Scotland) runs towards the goal to give his teammate support. He receives a fantastic pass and shoots from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the right post. It could have been a brilliant goal, unlucky.
16' 37:63 – the ratio of ball possession.
15' The foul by Wilson Isidor (Haiti) was seen by Mustapha Ghorbal who didn't hesitate to blow the whistle.

14' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) sends a lofted pass from the resulting free kick, but fails to hit the ball properly and his effort goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Scotland.
13' Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle for a foul after Che Adams (Scotland) hacks down one of his opponents. A free kick is awarded to Haiti.
13' Wilson Isidor (Haiti) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
11' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Haiti) latches onto a lofted pass on the edge of the penalty box and unleashes a volley towards goal, but it goes high over the crossbar.
10' Ruben Providence (Haiti) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Louicius Deedson.
9' It looks like Wilson Isidor (Haiti) saw red with that tackle. Mustapha Ghorbal won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
7' Mustapha Ghorbal blows his whistle as Wilson Isidor (Haiti) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
7' Andrew Robertson floats in a cross for Scott McTominay (Scotland), whose header from near the penalty spot is really poor and floats high over the bar.
5' Louicius Deedson (Haiti) receives a reproachful look from his teammates after he attempted to surprise the goalkeeper with a shot from long distance. The ball flew far wide of the right post.
4' Lawrence Shankland (Scotland) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
4' Frantzdy Pierrot (Haiti) commits a foul during an attacking move.
3' Ben Gannon-Doak (Scotland) is unlucky with a goal-bound effort from the edge of the box. Some classy goalkeeping by Johny Placide stops the ball out of the bottom right corner.
3' Scotland keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
1' Aaron Hickey (Scotland) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target. The ball goes out of play and Haiti will have a goal kick.
